name: 百度输入法
text:
#!name=百度输入法
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/r6\.mo\.baidu\.com\/res\/file\/advertisement\/files\/.+\.jpg/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/res\.mi\.baidu\.com\/imeres\/ime-res\/advertisement\/files\/.+\.jpg/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/activity\/advertisementnonrealtime/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/start_screen_ads\/list/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/hotpatch\/check\?hotpatch/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/start_screen_ads\/list/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/sapi\/v1\/lccorpus\/(applist|pannellist)/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/sapi\/v1\/circle\/joinedlist/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/commer\/pocket_api\/enterprise_list/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mbd\.baidu\.com\/ccs\/v1\/start\/confsync\?appname=baidu_input/i then reject_dict(200)

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% r6.mo.baidu.com, res.mi.baidu.com, mime.baidu.com, mbd.baidu.com
